provenance_legend.excel_static: Read from the workbook and unchanged by a recalculation.
provenance_legend.project_default_derived_from_randomized_: Project default inspired by a RANDBETWEEN snapshot; never a climate normal.
provenance_legend.project_default: Chosen by the project; absent from the workbook.
provenance_legend.admin_override: Set by a guild administrator for one channel.

derivation.temp_avg_c: Catalog avg_c snapshot used as the daily reference, not as a normal.
derivation.temp_cold_c: min(cold_c, avg_c - inner_bound): the envelope never crosses the core.
derivation.temp_hot_c: max(hot_c, avg_c + inner_bound): the envelope never crosses the core.
derivation.humidity_pct: base = 25 + 60 * p; min = base - 15; max = base + 20; clamped.
derivation.wind_kmh: Family range: calm 5-25, moderate 8-32, windy 10-40, cold 15-45.
derivation.cloud_cover_pct: min = 50 * p; max = 50 + 50 * p; clamped to 0..100.
derivation.visibility_km: 2 .. 40 - 25 * p, so wetter climates see less far.
